reviews.title: Purpose for headlamp
reviews.review_text: I use this headlamp for biking because someone kept stealing the bike lit that was attached to my front handlebar no matter where I went; when I was done shopping or whatever %26 I was ready to turn the bike light that was attached to the handlebars on %26 it was gone so after that happened about 4 times I could see that this energizer headlamp was what I needed cuz it went with me when I went shopping etc. This headlamp gives more light than a medium priced bike light %26 the straps can be easily adjusted to fit around my head;
Have not actually used it only opened it check batteries and brightness. Remove batteries and placed them in emergency kits. Will review more once used.
